summary.intent: Review codebase concerns, plan and capture E2E testing gaps as todos, add new roadmap phases for technical debt resolution, and use the GSD manager to drive discussion/planning/execution of multiple phases in parallel.
summary.outcome: Created 6 E2E/staging todos, added phases 28-32 to roadmap (PRs #380 and #381), discussed all 4 new phases requiring discussion, executed Phase 28 fully, planned Phases 29 and 30, and captured Phase 31 context with a revised SDK-first decomposition strategy.

repo: Only 1 of 12 E2E specs (recovery.spec.ts) deletes test accounts after runs — the other 11 leave orphaned accounts
deleteTestAccount() helper already exists but is unused in most specs
AES-CTR streaming uses CTR mode for media files >256KB, GCM for smaller files — 35 unit tests exist but zero E2E tests cover this path
Service worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for seeking
139 console.* calls across 29 web app source files (82 error, 27 warn, 18 log, 12 time/timeEnd) — hooks.ts alone has 34 due to Web3Auth debug logging
pino-browser's redact option is Node.js only and does not work in the browser — custom wrapper is correct choice for a ZK app needing sensitive field stripping
Grafana Faro has no session replay (privacy advantage), 50k sessions/month free tier vs Sentry's 5k errors, but 2 years old vs Sentry's 10

lint-staged runs markdownlint --fix on all *.md globs and passes explicit file paths, bypassing .markdownlintignore — planning docs need to be excluded from the lint-staged glob directly in package.json
unenrollIpns() exists in RepublishService at apps/api but has no REST endpoint — TODO in folder.service.ts has existed since Phase 14

Significant business logic is trapped in web app hooks that belongs in the SDK: tree validation (getDepth, isDescendantOf), buildSharedWriteCtx, withRevocationGuard, withConflictRetry, purgeExpired, share key caching with TTL

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper calls DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' } — exists but wired into only 1 of 12 specs
Mode selection: CTR for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else
Service worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs, handles HTTP Range requests for video seeking, uses BigInt counter math for random-access decryption
34 console calls from Web3Auth debug logging — highest concentration in web app. coreKit and loginParams typed as any but Web3AuthMPCCoreKit is exported from core-kit.ts
unenrollIpns() exists here but has no REST endpoint — wired up in Phase 29
TODO comment: 'Phase 14 should expose unenrollIpns via REST API' — deferred since Phase 14, resolved in Phase 29
1199 lines, zero unit tests — highest-risk fragile area. Contains buildSharedWriteCtx, withRevocationGuard, share key caching that belong in SDK, not React hooks
964 lines — ~600 lines of handler logic can be extracted to useFileBrowserActions hook, leaving ~365 lines of pure presentational JSX
1089 lines — tree validation helpers (getDepth, isDescendantOf, calculateSubtreeDepth) should migrate to SDK, not just be split into a web-layer module
4 silenced unpin catches replaced in Phase 28; purgeExpired() is framework-agnostic and could migrate to SDK
lint-staged markdownlint glob needed to exclude .planning/**/*.md to prevent asterisk escaping in GSD planning documents that broke manager JSON parsing

workflow: GSD manager enables parallel phase work: discuss runs inline while plan/execute run as background agents — Phase 28 was planned and executed while Phase 29 was being discussed
STATE.md todo counts can go stale between sessions — always verify actual file count before arithmetic when updating the count field
Adding a second executor agent to verify work already done by a worktree agent is a valid safety check — the second agent correctly reported 'already complete, no commits needed'

Asking 'could this be SDK logic rather than decomposed web modules' before finalizing decomposition strategy is the right architectural question — changed Phase 31 scope from file-splits to SDK migration
markdownlintignore is bypassed by lint-staged when it passes explicit file paths; the fix must be in the lint-staged glob pattern in package.json itself

friction: STATE.md pending todo count was stale (showed 10, was actually 6) — led to incorrect 6+4=10 then 10+4=14 arithmetic; caught by user

markdownlint lint-staged hook repeatedly escaped asterisks in ROADMAP.md (console.* became console.\*), breaking GSD manager JSON parsing — required 4 commits to fully resolve by excluding .planning/ from the lint-staged glob
Phase 28 executor was spawned twice — the second run was redundant because the first worktree agent completed all work including verification and state updates
Manager init JSON parsing failed mid-session due to the lint-staged asterisk escaping issue, requiring inline ROADMAP.md repair before dashboard could refresh
